FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.title: Void Cradle
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.INITI:
As you pass through a dim cave, you glimpse a mysterious deep-purple glow in the darkness.

Drawing closer, you discover a [purple][jitter]Void Cradle[/jitter][/purple]!

A black-hole-like orb floats above it. There seem to be [purple][jitter]rare treasures[/jitter][/purple] inside.

But you also notice [red][jitter]insects[/jitter][/red] sleeping within the cradle. You would rather not wake them.
Obtain [red]Putrefaction[/red]. Corrupt a random eligible relic you own into its corresponding [color=#B780B0]Void Relic[/color]. Requires an eligible relic.
You reach into the orb and pull out [purple][jitter]something[/jitter][/purple]!

[red]Ouch[/red]! It feels like insects have crawled onto you.
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.CORRU:
The orb swallows your relic. Moments later, a [purple]brand-new relic[/purple] falls to the ground.

As you reach for it, the [red][jitter]insects hiding underneath[/jitter][/red] immediately crawl onto you!
FROSTSWORN_EVENT_VOID_CRADLE.pages.LEAVE: You quietly walk away. You recognize those [red]insects[/red]. They are not easy to deal with.
